errors.text_span: Диаграмата представя разпределение на категориите в контекста на нормативен контрол и верификация на данни в база от данни,
errors.evidence: The description states the context of the chart is 'authority control and verification of data in a database', but the title written on the chart itself is 'Нормативен контрол (контролни файлове)' which translates to 'Authority control (authority files)'. The description uses information from the figure caption instead of the visible title on the image.
The label in the chart reads 'и др.' (abbreviation for 'and others'), not 'и гр.' (abbreviation for 'city'). This is a transcription error.
The label in the chart reads 'друго:', which is the singular form for 'other'. The description incorrectly uses the plural form 'други:'.
